name: scoped-approve
description: Approves without asking only the shell commands on an exact allow-list; never overrides a deny, never touches subagents

allowList.title: Allowed commands
allowList.description: Comma-separated. Each entry matches the command exactly or followed by arguments, e.g. git status, npm test

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the auto-approval off without uninstalling
